comment.body: Could you attach a PowerToys bug-report ZIP and a screenshot of the affected Keyboard Manager mappings, then list one exact source key, destination key, and application where it fails? Please confirm whether it also fails in Notepad, whether either app is elevated, and whether restarting PowerToys temporarily restores the mapping. It would also help to know when it first stopped working (after reboot, sleep, PowerToys update, or Windows update).
